quizzes.question_text: Nezuko had a goal of annotating at least 60% of the 200 articles for research by today. She actually finished annotating 132 articles. How many articles did Nezuko annotate more than her goal?
solution: First, find 60% of 200. Remember: "percent" means "per hundred," so 60% = $\frac{60}{100} = 0.6$.
Articles above goal = Actual - Goal = $132 - 120 = 12$ articles.

solution: Pages above goal = Actual - Goal = $315 - 300 = 15$ pages.

solution: To find what percent one number is of another, use: Percent = $\frac{\text{Part}}{\text{Whole}} \times 100$.
$\frac{1}{4} \times 100 = 25$%. So 25% of the class is left-handed.

A shirt originally costs 80 dollars. It is on sale for 20% off, and there is an additional 5% sales tax on the sale price. What is the final price?
 $__
